name: Sight of the Coven (Coven)
body:
Channel your spells through your coven members’ bonded objects and familiars.

Prerequisite(s): Coven member; possess an arcane bond, familiar, or soul focus.

Benefit(s): By concentrating as a full-round action, you can see through the arcane bonded object, familiar, or soul focus item of any coven member (including your own). While doing this, you are blind to what is around you.
